thesis: The episode explores the historical relationship between art and technology, arguing that artists have long used new mediums to express feelings about inhabiting contemporary technological moments. It features artist Simon Denny, who bridges the museum and crypto worlds by designing NFT projects that explore what is possible on new platforms, contrasting the optimistic, building-focused culture of tech entrepreneurs with the traditionally cynical attitude of his art peers.
